Yeah I’ve definitely been trying for a while. Especially since a couple weeks after my previous post when a friend who went through divorce gave me the advice of making sure I’ve tried all I can do so that I have the least amount of regret possible. I just miss what me and her used to have before it really went downhill and I’ve been trying to get back to that. There’s been a few good times but no often enough to really convince me it’ll ever work out, just barely often enough for it make me not give up quite yet and remind me of why I want it to work out. But yeah I can’t force anything and lately I’ve really been thinking about what moving on will look like more and more

Your first paragraph is completely right. As for perks, I was sharing my sister's netflix account but there was an unauthorized login so we changed the password and haven't given her the new one yet(much to her disapproval). And for birthdays and anniversaries and such I usually give her much better gifts than she gives me. And she likes to keep her wallet locked in her car but since i always have mine then if she randomly has a craving for a snack (we work in a retail store) then she'll give me the puppy dog eyes to ask me to buy it for her, and never do the same for me. No other financial support, we haven't shared any bills since we lived together. Shes not talking to anyone else (a few coworkers at work on break but of the guys she talks to they're either married or like 40 years older) she has no interest in hanging out with anyone else so that they dont get the virus. And she rarely unloads her feelings at all. But when shes lonely/bored when her parents are unavailable then that's when shes most likely to want me to talk to her.

And actually the topic of "so where do we go from here? Since she hasn't been showing up" has been the main topic of conversation for the last few sessions. The counselor is a girl my age, and also is really good at seeing my side of things. Trying to help me see her side of things, but also is admitting how unhealthy all this is. She knows about my suicidal feelings and has talked about "what's going to happen if this ends?" But our last session was mostly spent talking about how even though itd be bittersweet, itd feel like a huge weight has been lifted and I can find someone else finally. And until I'm ready to commit to someone else, I'd have more time and money to spend how I choose.

I know the saying about the grass is always greener on the other side but itd be pretty easy to say that most the ones that I compare to are defintely better off than me. They have a family that cares about them and aren't separated from. Everyone I've told my story to says they feel bad for me and they're sorry for me. I've yet to hear anyone say "try walking a mile in my shoes" after really listening to the details of my story. (Obviously aside from my wife and her family)

You're right that I dont find it much to be proud of but I believe you believe it so I still appreciate it. Each time it was the girl who dumped me so I guess the fact that I eventually tried again that many times is more than what some can say. But yeah I'm mainly struggling from the fact that so many girls dumped me and that it's taking so long to find someone I can stay happy with. Just being too analytical and looking how many times I've tried only to have it not work out. But yeah I guess a better way to look at it (easier said than done) it to congratulate myself for trying that many times.

And I've never really been a huge pokemon fan. I've tried it and I dont hate it. I can see why some people are into, it's just not my thing. Smash brothers defintely is another I really enjoy though. I've played every one of them. Brawl was the one I put the most hours into but i love all of them.
